face: Large green sclera/iris regions with dark green pupils, orange skin, pointed/angular red bangs, small nose, expressive original2003 face.

equipment: Pair of long open-hand blue-grey/silver bracers with green circular wrist gems, high neck collar with round green chest gem; starbolts are innate energy, not a gun.
distinguishingMarks: Single narrow upper-arm band on anatomical RIGHT; no band on left upper arm.
